'''Tommik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Corellian Council]] during the [[Galactic War]] and was among those who helped bring [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] into the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]].
